author: raykholo

sources.title: HIWIN "MG Series" product page photo (visual reference only)

vars.name: mat
vars.expr: material == "M" ? "stainless" : (material == "HC" ? "carbon steel + hard chrome" : (material == "NC" ? "carbon steel + coating" : "carbon steel"))

vars.name: code
vars.expr: caps == "" ? code_in : concat("MGN", size, block, eblock, n_blocks, "R", length, erail, preload, precision, material, rails)

vars.name: lube
vars.expr: b.G > 0 ? concat("grease nipple M3, projection G ", b.G, " mm, on the +X end of each block") : concat("lube hole O", b.Gn, " at ", b.H2, " mm below the block top, in both end faces")

vars.name: desc0
vars.expr:
concat("HIWIN MGN", size, block, " linear guide set: rail MGNR", size, " L=", length, " mm (", holes, " holes, end distance ", end_d, " mm) with ", n_blocks, " block(s).
DIMENSIONED (catalogue values, HIWIN MG Series catalogue G99TE24-2410): rail ", r.WR, " x ", r.HR, " mm, counterbored holes O", r.D, " x ", r.h, " deep, through O", r.d, ", pitch ", r.P, "; block ", b.W, " wide, ", b.L, " long with end seals (steel body ", b.L1, "), H ", b.H, ", H1 ", b.H1)

vars.name: desc1
vars.expr:
concat(", four ", b.M, "x", b.M_depth, " threads at B ", b.B, " x C ", b.C, "; ", lube, "; L Max ", b.Lmax, " mm. The 10 mm gap between blocks is an illustration choice.", "
APPEARANCE (approximate, not a catalogue dimension; shapes from HIWIN's published drawings and photo): rail top chamfers (", rch, " mm) and two side ball grooves (radius ", grr)

vars.name: desc2
vars.expr: concat(" mm, a circular approximation of the groove, which the catalogue does not dimension); block top chamfers; a black top insert 0.2 mm deep between the mounting holes (HIWIN's photo shows a black middle band between metal ends); plastic end caps (", capw, " mm) and end seals (", seal)

vars.name: desc3
vars.expr: concat(" mm) per end, the cap / seal split is an estimate; retainer strips; two cross-head end screws per end; the grease nipple shape. All these bodies are named '(appearance, approximate)'.", caps == "caps" ? concat(" Bolt caps in the rail holes: catalogue O", r.cap_d, " x ", r.cap_h, " thick (Table 2-4-9, a press fit), modelled flush at the counterbore diameter.") : "", " Rail screws: ISO 4762 ", r.bolt)

vars.name: desc4
vars.expr: concat(" from SolidCraft's standard parts (the catalogue gives the bolt size, not the screw model).")

rules.refuse: MGNR{size} max single length is {r.max_len} mm
rail length {length} leaves end distance {end_txt} < {r.Es} mm (L = (n - 1) P + 2 E, E at least Es)
{n_blocks} blocks: this generator draws 1 to 4 blocks on a rail
MGN{size}: the catalogue lists bolt caps for MGN12 and MGN15 only (S4 Table 2-4-9)
